statement.zh: 主张只经耦合入者的差别被排除，相对于模型的排除是对模型与主张一起的排除。成员只经自己的耦合回应时，耦合闭包之外的不在其中显出；检验是关系的。
statement.en: A claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in, and exclusion relative to a model excludes the model and the claim together. Where members respond only through their own couplings, nothing beyond the coupling closure shows within it; testing is relational.

laws.zh: 耦合入形成的，是它的支持（水平是否接纳它），经阈，与经水平耦合入它之条件的水平；基础只有支持耦合入。在两个水平历史之下，在某步水平同样接纳它、经水平耦合入的条件同样立着，就是在该步经其耦合无别；直到某步每步如此，就是直到该步经其耦合无别。
laws.en: Into a formation couple its support (whether the levels admit it), by threshold, and the levels of the conditions coupled into it by level; into the base only support couples. Two level histories are alike through its couplings at a step when the levels admit it alike and its conditions coupled in by level stand alike, and alike through them up to a step when they are so at every step up to it.

laws.zh: 其余耦合入的条件相同时，只经阈耦合入的条件只传递它是否满足所需；经水平耦合入的条件传递其水平；经水平耦合入的越多，分辨得越多。
laws.en: With every other condition coupled in alike, a condition coupled in by threshold only passes only whether it meets the need; one coupled in by level passes its level; the more couples in by level, the more is told apart.

laws.zh: 关于水平历史的主张在某步被排除，是指满足它的历史没有一个直到该步经形成的耦合与实际无别：主张只经耦合入者的差别被排除，成立的永不被排除，排除此后一直成立，经水平耦合入的越多，排除得越多。
laws.en: A claim about level histories is excluded at a step when no history meeting it is alike with the actual one through the formation's couplings up to that step: a claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in, what holds is never excluded, an exclusion stands, and the more couples in by level, the more is excluded.

laws.zh: 没有模型时，对任何有限的前段，“某条件将归于无”与“它此后一直在无之上”都不被排除。
laws.en: Without a model, for any finite prefix, neither the claim that a condition comes to nothing nor the claim that it stays above nothing afterwards is excluded.

laws.zh: 相对于模型（可容许历史的类）的排除恰是对模型与主张一起的排除；以流的平衡水平历史为模型、实际历史是其中之一时，储量经水平耦合入的形成在第一步排除一切“它将归于无”的假主张；错的模型排除成立的，耦合入者排除模型。
laws.en: Exclusion relative to a model, a class of admissible histories, is exactly exclusion of the model and the claim together; relative to a flow's balanced level histories, the actual one among them, a formation into which a stock couples by level excludes at the first step every false claim that it comes to nothing; a wrong model excludes what holds, and what couples in excludes the model.

laws.zh: 经形成之耦合无别之类，是经其耦合与实际无别的历史；排除是主张与这个类不交；经其耦合作出的判断恰是 Becoming.Inquiry 中判断过程在这个类上的共同回应，更晚的步与更多的耦合使类收窄，都保持它。
laws.en: The class alike through a formation's couplings is the histories alike with the actual one through them; exclusion is a claim disjoint from that class; a judgment made through the couplings is exactly a common response of the judging process of Becoming.Inquiry over the class, kept as later steps and more coupling narrow it.

laws.zh: 形成依存于一个条件，或该条件经水平耦合入它，该条件就耦合入它；耦合闭包是对经耦合入者受影响的闭包，含影响闭包，只有支持耦合入时就是它，随经水平的耦合与交换增大。
laws.en: A condition couples into a formation when the formation depends on it or it couples in by level; the coupling closure is the closure under being affected through what couples in, holding the influence closure, equal to it where only support couples in, and growing with coupling by level and with exchange.

laws.zh: 两个流相同的形成在场、在耦合入一个区域之成员的每个条件上逐步平衡，区域在两个流中都对经耦合入者受影响封闭，水平起始在耦合入成员的条件上相同，每个成员在两个流经其耦合无别之处对耦合入成员的条件同样取用与给予时，两个流每步都经每个成员的耦合无别。
laws.en: For two flows with the same formations present, balancing at each step on every condition coupled into a member of a region, the region closed in both under being affected through what couples in, the levels starting alike on what couples into members, and each member taking from and giving to what couples into members alike wherever the flows have been alike through its couplings, the flows are alike through every member's couplings at every step.

laws.zh: 其余交换固定、在耦合入闭包内者的条件上逐步平衡时：成员都在耦合闭包之外的部分，闭包之内每步有与无它都经其耦合无别；无部分的水平所满足的主张在闭包之内不被排除；相对于模型的排除靠模型对部分之交换的排除；闭包之内的判断在有与无部分时都可容许。
laws.en: With the rest of the exchange fixed and balance at each step on what couples in within the closure, the worlds with and without a part whose members all lie beyond the coupling closure are alike through the couplings within it at every step; no claim met by the levels without it is excluded there; an exclusion there relative to a model rests on the model excluding its exchange; a judgment there is admissible with and without it.

laws.zh: Clearing 中两个世界每步都经清除者的耦合无别，无论清除是否终结栖居者；在不清除的世界中，“栖居者已被终结”被清除者在任何一步都不排除，被栖居者在第三步排除；“第三步栖居者或清除者不被接纳”，两者各自都不排除，合起来排除。
laws.en: In Clearing the worlds are alike through the clearer's couplings at every step whether or not its clearing ends the dweller; with the habitat spared, the claim that the dweller is ended is excluded by the clearer at no step and by the dweller at the third step; the claim that the dweller or the clearer is not admitted at the third step is excluded by neither alone and by the two together.

laws.zh: 以固定起始与交换的模型，清除者在第一步排除不耦合入它的。
laws.en: With a model fixing the start and the exchange, the clearer excludes at the first step what does not couple into it.

laws.zh: Prey 中不依存于自身的猎物，捕食者在其影响闭包之外、量度自身时的耦合闭包之内：有与无捕食者的部分，两个世界经猎物的支持每步无别，量度自身则在被咬之后传递其取用；这靠被省略的关系。
laws.en: In Prey, the prey not depending on itself, the predator lies beyond its influence closure and within its coupling closure under a gauge of itself: the worlds with and without the predator's part are alike through the prey's support at every step, and the gauge passes the taking after the bite; this rests on omitted relations.

hypotheses.zh: 耦合与排除的定义不设前提；模型是给出的可容许历史类。
hypotheses.en: The definitions of coupling and exclusion assume nothing; a model is a supplied class of admissible histories.

hypotheses.zh: 平衡只在耦合入的条件上逐步假设（Flow.BalancesOn，单元素家族，不需要有限性）；整体的平衡经 Flow.Balances.on 给出它。
hypotheses.en: Balance is assumed only on the conditions coupled in, at each step (Flow.BalancesOn, singleton families, needing no finiteness); global balance gives it through Flow.Balances.on.

hypotheses.zh: Flow.alike_within_closed 另设区域在两个流中封闭、起始相同与成员只经自己的耦合回应，都是给出的假设：他者怎样回应是给出的。有与无部分的比较用扣留水平（Flow.WithheldLevels，其余交换不变，是表示上的选择）；部分是判定的形成家族。
hypotheses.en: Flow.alike_within_closed further assumes the region closed in both flows, the starts alike, and the members responding only through their own couplings, all supplied: how others respond is supplied. The comparison with and without a part uses withheld levels (Flow.WithheldLevels, the rest of the exchange unchanged, a choice of the representation); a part is a decided family of formations.

hypotheses.zh: 耦合：支持与经水平耦合入之条件的水平（obs，参数）；活动由表示给出，不算作耦合入者。排除是对一个形成、在一步、在一个水平历史之下的；主张是关于水平历史的任何命题。
hypotheses.en: Coupling: support and the levels of the conditions coupled in by level (obs, a parameter); activity is supplied by the representation and is not counted as coupled in. Exclusion is by one formation, at a step, under one level history; a claim is any proposition about level histories.

hypotheses.zh: 形成自身的立着是否算作耦合入者（Ren 的第 4 问，当时问的是“是否被识”）由 AI 探索后决定：基础只有支持耦合入（thresholdOnly）；一类读法中自身的立着经承担自身（Web.SelfBearing）经阈耦合入；量度自身（ownStanding）是经水平耦合的前提。理由见整合文档。
hypotheses.en: Whether a formation's own standing counts as coupled in (Ren's question 4, asked then as whether it is registered) was decided by the AI after exploring the options: only support couples into the base (thresholdOnly); in the one-kind reading own standing couples in by threshold through self-bearing (Web.SelfBearing); a gauge of oneself (ownStanding) is a premise of coupling by level. The reasons are in the integration note.

hypotheses.zh: 见证的结论：各见证的流、网与模型（Clearing、Prey、Stationary）。
hypotheses.en: For the witnesses: their flows, webs and models (Clearing, Prey, Stationary).

hypotheses.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量；条件上的判定相等（DecidableEq）只在按条件分情形处使用，不用经典推理。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts; decidable equality of conditions (DecidableEq) is used only to split cases on conditions, and no classical reasoning is used.

does_not_show.zh: 反馈的三种不见各只在其范围内成立：阈下在交换随耦合入者之处，视界之外在延续开放之处，耦合闭包之外在成员只经自己的耦合回应之处。
does_not_show.en: Each feedback blindness holds only in its scope: below threshold where exchange follows what couples in, beyond the horizon where continuation is open, beyond the coupling closure where members respond only through their own couplings.

does_not_show.zh: 这些规律不推出有支持之外的东西经水平耦合入形成，也不推出形成形成模型、想要检验或知道其耦合闭包。
does_not_show.en: The laws do not derive that anything beyond its support couples into a formation by level, that it forms a model, wants to test or knows its coupling closure.

does_not_show.zh: 经耦合无别界定能分辨的，不说一个差别关于什么。
does_not_show.en: Being alike through the couplings bounds what can be told apart and says nothing of what a difference is about.

does_not_show.zh: 一个动作造成什么是对两段历史的比较，只相对于无此动作之历史的模型才可检验；变动自己的动作而差别经耦合显出（实验）在这里没有陈述。
does_not_show.en: What an act does compares two histories and is testable only relative to a model of the history without it; varying one's own act and the difference showing through the couplings (experiment) is not stated here.

detail.zh: 相对于模型的排除可以出错：Stationary 中模型说没有取用与给予，相对于它，量度储量的形成在第一步排除“储量将归于无”，而这在实际中成立（Stationary.model_error）。
detail.en: Exclusion relative to a model can err: in Stationary the model says nothing takes or gives, and relative to it a formation gauging the stock excludes at the first step the claim that the stock comes to nothing, which holds of the actual history (Stationary.model_error).

detail.zh: 耦合闭包可以严格大于影响闭包：Prey 中捕食者在猎物的影响闭包之外，量度自身时在其耦合闭包之内（Prey.couples_taking）；耦合入的差别对猎物不起作用，猎物不承担自身（Prey.omits），所以这一见证靠被省略的关系。
detail.en: The coupling closure can be strictly larger than the influence closure: in Prey the predator lies beyond the prey's influence closure and, under a gauge of itself, within its coupling closure (Prey.couples_taking); the difference coupled in does nothing to the prey, which does not bear on itself (Prey.omits), so the witness rests on omitted relations.

next_delta.zh: 多步 Scope 的桥：只经耦合感知的策略在经其耦合无别的流上有同样的所见范围；模型从哪里来（见 projection-carrying-a-law 与 generalization-through-lumping）；由动力学给出回应，而不是另给它；耦合入者关于什么（校准）；耦合入者不分辨值时（阈下）的学习。
next_delta.en: The multi-step Scope bridge: a policy sensing only through its couplings has the same visible scope on flows alike through them; where a model comes from (see projection-carrying-a-law, generalization-through-lumping); responses given by the dynamics, not supplied; calibration; learning below threshold.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议：“can becoming provide wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks and the identification of knowledge, learning, and scientific principles like falsifiability”，“I think all the wisdoms about wisdoms, how to think, learn, update, are all explained within what we have, if not not proved yet”。AI 的回答提出反馈的三种不见、失控是在其一之中运行的回路、跨过它们的方式、可否证性是被展开纠正的条件，以及 理 的读法；Ren 答：“agree with you, great job, start now. for 4, you can explore which option is better, then make decision”。独立审查收窄了这些读法：三种不见各有其范围（见“未表明”）；失控的读法是启发，不是陈述；理 原由 AI 读作对识负责的模型，现依 Ren 2026-10-12 的读法，为对结构与变化之规律的建模；模型仍只经耦合入者被检验（generalization-through-lumping）。所以记录中的读法是 AI 收窄之后的，依 Ren 的交托采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D26），不是 Ren 所接受的原文。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal: “can becoming provide wisdoms to avoid run away feedbacks and the identification of knowledge, learning, and scientific principles like falsifiability”, and “I think all the wisdoms about wisdoms, how to think, learn, update, are all explained within what we have, if not not proved yet”. The AI's answer proposed three blindnesses of feedback, a runaway as a loop running inside one of them, the ways across them, falsifiability as the condition of being corrected by the unfolding, and a reading of 理; Ren answered “agree with you, great job, start now. for 4, you can explore which option is better, then make decision”. The independent review narrowed the readings: each blindness has its scope (a does-not-show item states it); the runaway reading is a heuristic, not a statement; and 理, read by the AI as a model answerable to registration, is now read as Ren read it on 12 October 2026, the modeling of the laws of structure and of change; a model is still tested only through what couples in (generalization-through-lumping). So the readings here are the AI's narrowed ones, adopted on Ren's delegation (DELEGATED-CHOICES D26), not the wording Ren accepted.

detail.zh: 推广 P42 的 Flow.Balances.uncoupled_beyond_influence（加入经水平的耦合，并以成员有回应的形式 Flow.alike_within_closed 为其根据；只有支持耦合入时 Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling 就是它），复用 Flow.Exchanges、Flow.WithinInfluence、Clearing.sparedFlow、sparedWeb、spared_balances 与 spared_dependent；这里的实质增量是 alike_within_closed，不是固定其余交换的形式。
detail.en: Extends P42's Flow.Balances.uncoupled_beyond_influence (adding coupling by level, and grounding it in the form where the members respond, Flow.alike_within_closed; where only support couples in, Flow.uncoupled_beyond_coupling is it), and reuses Flow.Exchanges, Flow.WithinInfluence, Clearing.sparedFlow, sparedWeb, spared_balances and spared_dependent; the substantive delta here is alike_within_closed, not the fixed-rest form.

output.zh: 交换、影响闭包与不清除的世界。
output.en: Exchange, the influence closure and the world with the habitat spared.

input.zh: 耦合闭包及其不见；清除者不检验栖居者被终结。
input.en: The coupling closure and its blindness; the clearer does not test whether the dweller is ended.

detail.en: Reuses ClosedUnder, WithinClosure (mono, not_rel, of_rel, refl, trans), closedUnder_withinClosure and Web.DependsOn.

input.en: The coupling closure and its closedness.

input.zh: 经耦合无别的第一项；有与无部分的比较。
input.en: The first clause of being alike through the couplings; the comparison with and without a part.

detail.zh: 复用 Clearing.unsupported_with：清除时栖居者从第三步起不被支持。
detail.en: Reuses Clearing.unsupported_with: with the clearing the dweller is unsupported from the third step on.

input.zh: Clearing.DwellerEnded 在清除的世界中成立。
input.en: Clearing.DwellerEnded holds in the world with the clearing.

detail.zh: 那里是经阈的耦合与交换随耦合入者时阈下差别的规律；这里是耦合、排除、所及与检验的关系性。
detail.en: There coupling by threshold and the laws of differences below it where the exchange follows what couples in; here coupling, exclusion, reach and the relational character of testing.

detail.zh: 那里有限的前缀不决定更新还是消耗，其两个推论 no_exact_finite_reading 与 finite_reading_withholds_renewal 也在 Becoming.Testing 中；这里没有模型时有限的前段不排除关于其后的主张，相对于模型则可以。
detail.en: There no finite prefix decides renewal or consumption, and its two corollaries no_exact_finite_reading and finite_reading_withholds_renewal are also in Becoming.Testing; here without a model no finite prefix excludes a claim about what follows it, while relative to a model one can.

detail.zh: 外围的信息界：保持同样读数的适应关系不能同时满足更强的覆盖；这里在脊柱上，经耦合无别者不被分辨，主张只经耦合入者的差别被排除。
detail.en: The periphery's information bound: adaptive relations preserving the same readouts cannot also meet stronger coverage; here on the spine, what is alike through the couplings is not told apart, and a claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in.

detail.zh: 那里一切前缀问题都可以漏掉中间的损失；这里没有模型时有限的前段不排除关于其后的主张。
detail.en: There every prefix question can omit an intermediate loss; here without a model no finite prefix excludes a claim about what follows it.

detail.zh: 这一开放目标的一个部分：在脊柱上陈述被展开排除的条件与相对于模型的排除；不确立整个目标。
detail.en: One part of this open target: the condition of being excluded by the unfolding, and exclusion relative to a model, stated on the spine; it does not establish the whole target.

detail.zh: 实验：变动自己的动作而差别经耦合显出；记录只在运行取用之处固定动作的结果。
detail.en: Experiment: varying one's own act and the difference showing through the couplings; a record fixes a move's outcome only where the run took it.

There what a formation couples into carries a law along one run exactly where the occasions it couples alike went alike; an uncoupled level can decide its next coupling (Unseen): the boundary here, read along a course.
detail.zh: 那里形成所耦合者沿一个运行承载规律，恰在它耦合相同的场合同去之处；一个未耦合的水平可以决定它下一步耦合什么（Unseen）：这里的边界沿进程读出。

history.zh: 2026-10-14 迁移到 schema 2（开放问题计划 F 项：lint 发现最多的 45 条 schema-1 记录的迁移；Ren：“please, do all”，经整合会话转达）：主张拆为 12 条规律；限制分入“未表明”、前提、通用边界与下一步；证据成为一段。三条规律写出定理所带、旧文本靠上下文的条件：阈值之律写出“其余所识条件相同时”（alike_of_threshold 的 others），储量之律写出“实际历史是其中之一”（refutes_tail_within 的 history），固定其余交换之律写出“在识闭包内所识的条件上逐步平衡”（balanced）。Prey 一句改写为定理所说：猎物经支持每步把捕食者的部分识得相同，量度自身则在被咬之后识其取用（旧英文 “registering alike … and through the gauge after the bite” 易误读）。“不用 Lean 公理”与前提中没有伦理前提，引用通用边界 no-ethical-premise。对应中三种不见的范围成为“未表明”第一项，理 一句压缩，被取代的读法与 Ren 的读法都保留；第 4 问的决定移入前提；“识”一名的来历移入此处：原作“计入”，与 P42 一致；Ren 认为“计入 is apparently weird, need better word”，AI 先改为“反映”，Ren 定为“识”（“for registers, use 识”），取差别在形成的状态中显出之义（见整合文档 §70.2；旧中文对应在此处的节号是未替换的占位符 §{SEC}.2，英文为 §70.2）。限制中“多步 Scope 的桥仍开放”由下一步承担，“他者怎样回应是给出的”并入回应的前提。next_delta 中 P65、P66、P73 的括注是已完成的连接，移入此处：P66 给出哪些投影承载模型（恰是投影相同的配置同去者，projection-carrying-a-law），P73 给出模型的推广何时正确（恰在世界经它所归并者同去之处，generalization-through-lumping），P65 另给其余经其识回应，并把比较定在回应所及之内；其中“what a registration is about (calibration)”与“learning where registration does not tell values apart (below threshold)”缩为“calibration”“learning below threshold”。规律、前提、状态、证明绑定与来源哈希均未改变。每句旧文本的去向见迁移对照表 [testing-within-registration.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/testing-within-registration.md)；迁移前的完整记录为 text_versions 末项。
history.en: 14 October 2026, migrated to schema 2 (item F of the open-issues plan: the migration of the 45 schema-1 records with the most lint findings; Ren: “please, do all”, relayed by the integrating session): the claim became 12 laws; the limitations went to does-not-show items, hypotheses, standard boundaries and next_delta; the evidence became one paragraph. Three laws state conditions their theorems carry that the old text left to context: the threshold law, “with every other registered condition alike” (alike_of_threshold's others); the stock law, “the actual one among them” (refutes_tail_within's history); the fixed-rest law, “balance at each step on what is registered within the closure” (balanced). The Prey sentence now says what the theorem says: the prey registers the predator's part alike through support at every step, and the gauge of its own standing registers the taking after the bite (the old “registering alike … and through the gauge after the bite” could be misread). “No Lean axiom is used”, with no ethical premise among the hypotheses, cites the standard boundary no-ethical-premise. In the correspondence, the scopes of the three blindnesses became the first does-not-show item and the sentence on 理 was condensed, keeping both the replaced reading and Ren's; the decision on question 4 moved to the hypotheses; the history of the name “registers” moved here: its Chinese was 计入, as in P42; Ren found it “apparently weird” and asked for a better word, the AI proposed 反映, and Ren chose 识 (“for registers, use 识”): a difference showing in the formation's state (§70.2 of the integration note; the old Chinese correspondence had an unreplaced placeholder §{SEC}.2 there, the English §70.2). In the limitations, “the multi-step Scope bridge remains open” is carried by next_delta, and “how others respond is supplied” joined the response hypothesis. The parentheses of P65, P66 and P73 in next_delta are completed connections and are kept here: P66 states which projections carry a model (exactly those under which configurations alike go alike, projection-carrying-a-law), P73 when a model's generalization is right (exactly where the world goes alike across what it lumps, generalization-through-lumping), and P65 supplies that the rest responds through its registration and decides the comparison within the responsive reach; “what a registration is about (calibration)” and “learning where registration does not tell values apart (below threshold)” are shortened to “calibration” and “learning below threshold”. No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [testing-within-registration.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/testing-within-registration.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.
